shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "find .. -name AGENTS.md -print && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- auth ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/lib/auth.ts && printf '\\n--- page ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "find /workspace -name AGENTS.md -print && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- auth ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/lib/auth.ts && printf '\\n--- page ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- forbidden function ---' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/forbidden.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- forbidden file ---' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/forbidden.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---' && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/authInterrupts.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- config type ---' && rg -n \"authInterrupts\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/admin-headers.txt -o /tmp/admin-body.html http://localhost:3000/admin && cat /tmp/admin-headers.txt && printf '\\n--- body checks ---\\n' && rg -o \"403 Forbidden|Admin access required|Return home\" /tmp/admin-body.html | sort -u && printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app/admin/page.tsx app/forbidden.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git checkout -- tsconfig.json && git status --short && printf '\\n--- admin page ---\\n' && nl -ba app/admin/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- forbidden page ---\\n' && nl -ba app/forbidden.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && nl -ba next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- next.config.ts && git diff --no-index /dev/null app/admin/page.tsx || true && git diff --no-index /dev/null app/forbidden.tsx || true'
